title: Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius (PSX) - Polygon Space (Boss)
description:
This BG is seen at the end of the level where you fight Robot Wall to end the level. Used Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting Feature and did some tile corrections. Use slow or slower horizontal scrolling for good results.

Uses the second half of palette row 4.

No credit needed.

Small update: Moved the tiles from the FG2 slot to BG3 slot.
